<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Generalises plan 222's compaction wake to any idle stretch. A seat holding a role holding or a claim, idle 60 minutes, with no live owned background job and nothing queued, gets one resume-or-report message, and its prime an FYI, once per idle stretch, inside the existing watchdog round. One coder.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A seat that holds work and sits idle for an hour gets one nudge, and its prime one FYI, so ready work never stalls silently.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Nudging seats that hold nothing.
- Any per-tick work for every seat.
- Replacing plan 222's compaction wake or s12's role limits.

| ac-0001 | A seat holding work that sits idle gets nudged once. When a seat holds a live role holding or an open claim, has been idle (its last own event older than 60 minutes; seat.activity idle doesn't count as its own work, as in plan 222), has no live background job it owns, and has nothing queued for it, the daemon sends it ONE normal message from pij-bg: 'idle 60 min while holding &lt;holdings&gt;; resume, report blocked, or release'. Its prime (the project's designated prime, else its parent) gets one FYI naming the seat, holdings and idle time. Once per idle stretch: any own event re-arms it. A seat with a pending plan 222 compaction wake is left to that wake. <a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

F136 (crane's PEC friction 7, relayed by the prime 08 Nov 19:25): OSK's merger finished a green background gate, then sat idle for 5 h holding 4 ready PRs, and nothing flagged it. Plan 222 (#167) only wakes a seat after a compaction. s12's role default_limit catches only work sent as a role request. The prime: a seat holding a role holding or a claim, idle 60 min, with no live background job, gets one FYI to its prime (once per idle stretch, in the existing round, no launches) and one 'you hold X; resume or report' to the seat.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
